WITH order_payment_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id AS order_id,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(op.payment_installments, 0)) > 1 THEN 'installments'
            ELSE 'single_payment'
        END AS payment_type_category,
        ABS(SUM(COALESCE(op.payment_value, 0))) AS order_value
    FROM order_payments AS op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
    opr.payment_type_category,
    AVG(opr.order_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM order_payment_rollup AS opr
GROUP BY opr.payment_type_category
ORDER BY opr.payment_type_category;
